title: Update SPEC to reference README and test examples
description:
Update SPEC.md to follow the layered documentation approach: reference examples rather than duplicate them.

## Changes Needed

### CLI Interface Section

Currently says "The complete CLI specification is defined in src/cli.rs" but doesn't link to examples.

Update to:
- Brief description of each command
- Link to README example: "Example: [Quick Start](README.md#quick-start)"
- Link to comprehensive test: "See [test](tests/workflows/readme-example.trycmd)"
- Don't duplicate command output

### Jujutsu Integration Section

Already updated with correct behavior, but should reference examples showing it in action.

### Other Sections

Review each section for opportunities to link rather than duplicate:
- File renaming behavior → link to test showing it
- Relationship validation → link to test showing constraint errors
- ID resolution → link to test showing prefix matching

## Format

**Before (duplicative):**
```markdown
### new Command

Creates a new issue with title and optional description.
Output shows full issue details including ID, title, type...
[full output shown]
```

**After (referential):**
```markdown
### new Command

Syntax: `pebbles new <title> [options]`

Creates issue and commits to jj. Returns created issue.

Example: [Quick Start](README.md#quick-start)
Test coverage: [workflows/readme-example.trycmd](tests/workflows/readme-example.trycmd)
```

## Success Criteria

- SPEC references examples, doesn't duplicate them
- All major commands have example links
- No duplicate console output in SPEC
- SPEC remains accurate technical reference
